description: Read the Netherlands' official statistics from Statistics Netherlands (CBS): consumer prices and inflation, population by municipality, jobs and unemployment, GDP, housing, trade and thousands more StatLine tables, in English or Dutch. Search the tables, see what a table holds, get its figures as clean rows by region, category and period, or the latest CPI, population, unemployment rate or GDP growth in one step. No account or API key required.
